column1: # Benchmark index levels for the `banking-pipeline benchmark` value-add
# report. Copy to data/benchmarks.csv and replace with real figures.
# Format: `date` (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM) plus one column per benchmark.
# Each cell is the benchmark's INDEX LEVEL on that date — use a GBP
# total-return series (an accumulating tracker fund's NAV
# so it's comparable to the mandate's holdings-based return. Levels are
# sampled at the mandate's statement dates (as-of the nearest on/before)
# and a period return is level_end / level_start - 1
# matter — any consistent starting base is fine. Blank cells are allowed
# (a benchmark that starts later); lines beginning with `#` are ignored.
# Suggested benchmarks: a global 60/40 equity/bond blend (the usual yard-
# stick for a balanced mandate) and a 100% global-equity index. Replace
# these illustrative levels with month-end values you source yourself.
